title: A constructible subset of a retrocompact open is constructible in the ambient space
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, let $U\subseteq X$ be an open subset that is retrocompact in $X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset] (that is, $U\cap W$ is quasi-compact for every quasi-compact open $W\subseteq X$), with the subspace topology, and let $G\subseteq U$ be a constructible subset of the topological space $U$ [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Then $G$ is a constructible subset of $X$ (Stacks Topology, Lemma 09YD).
